## What's new

- **PC button joins the status bar.** The PC button now sits top right, in the same Liquid Glass capsule as the clock, controller, network and battery. iOS 26 groups them natively.
  - It shows the PC icon with its status dot: green online, grey offline, orange not paired. Next to it is the small arrow, or **□** when a controller is connected.
  - Tapping it opens the native PC menu, which now starts with "Connected to <PC name>". **□** opens the navigable PC panel, now also at the top right.
- The top left of the screen is now clear.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
